label: rem:quantum-entropy-remark
title: Surface independence of the quantum entropy
html: The measurability conditions c_1(\mathcal{F}) = 0 and c_2(\mathcal{F}) = 0 ensure that the surface integral defining S_q(U) is independent of the choice of bounding surface, via the Yekutieli non-abelian Stokes theorem.
heading: Remark
